exposure: Carboplatin (intraperitoneal injection at 6 mg/kg body weight on 7th day of gestation)
outcome: Nephrotoxicity (increased periglomerular space, degeneration and loss of proximal convoluted tubules, loss of distal convoluted tubules in kidney embryos)
cohort: Forty pregnant female albino mice (average weight 20 +/-3 gm, age 80-100 days) and their developing embryos were studied.
finding: Carboplatin, when injected intraperitoneally on the 7th day of gestation, was found to be teratogenic and induced nephrotoxicity in developing mice embryos, characterized by increased periglomerular space and severe loss of kidney tubules.
gest_age: Embryos were exposed on day 7 of gestation and fetuses were collected on day 19 of gestation.
